name: prospector
description: Lead-generation system for a web-redesign business: gather companies within a defined scope, store rich dossiers (sector, revenue, employees — not website quality), capture + taste-audit their websites, score the money×bad-site×site-matters opportunity, and prep outreach. Runs as a standalone local app (`npm start`): an HTML dashboard over a filesystem store, a watch-loop for deterministic actions, and a headless `claude` agent-runner that drains hunt/deep-dive autonomously — no separate Claude session required.
